name: Evolits
detailed_description:
HARNESS THE POWER OF EVOLITS WITH FRIENDS

Evolits is a creature-collecting open-world roguelite featuring turn-based PvE and PvP combat. Explore vast procedurally generated worlds, assemble a mighty team of Evolits, and engage in strategic combat against powerful bosses in every run. Best of all, do it all with up to two friends.

BRING TOGETHER YOUR TEAM

Build a collection of Evolits that suit your playstyle. Customise them with abilities, training, fusion, and runes. Use impactful potions to enhance their power. Develop mastery by creating new, engaging, intricate builds in every run.

REFRESHING WORLD GENERATION

Each world is designed with Metroidvania mechanics in mind, featuring unlockable areas that encourage exploration. The areas contain unique spawns and terrain; however, various patterns can be understood and exploited to find the items you desire. The world generation makes each run a skilful race against time to obtain a cohesive build.

RETAIN PROGRESSION

A persistent world exists outside of the roguelite runs, where parts of progression are retained to be used in future runs. Various events and features can also be found there, including player trade, ranked PvP, achievement challenges, and quests.

This game has cross-platform play with mobile.
